plan.description: Freeze sample identities, design, filters, transformation, thresholds and group-restricted permutations before reading the matrix.
Admit hashed unique sample/feature identities and finite observed values, retaining missingness and named exclusions.
Compute exact confounding rank, unadjusted variance/centroid metrics, stratified permutation pseudo-F and QC dispersion.
Preserve failed controls and classify technical structure under the frozen thresholds, with confounding unassessable.
Register ordinary hashed artifacts and separate claims for coordinator-owned independent review.
